name: Erythema nodosum
advice: Rest with legs raised and use crepe bandage/stockings. Tests: CBC, ESR/CRP, ASO, chest X-ray, Mantoux/IGRA, urine pregnancy test; slit-skin smear if leprosy suspected. Lumps settle in 3–6 weeks once the cause is treated. Potassium iodide is avoided in pregnancy and thyroid disease.
